name: Komeco KOS 09QC 3HX
notes:
Based on the 1581.json codeset from SmartIR (Chigo ZH/TY-01); 1,156 states.

The original codeset was expanded to add support for the four swing modes: off, vertical, horizontal, and both.

The heat_cool / fan:auto / 22 °C frame was corrected by adding the missing timing pair.

The heat_cool / fan:auto / 23–31 °C frames were corrected to send the proper temperature (they were sending T+1).

The resulting codeset uses the same ZH/LT-01 protocol implemented by ESPHome’s zhlt01 component.

Likely compatible with other air conditioners using the ZH/LT-01 / ZH/TY-01 (ZHLT01) protocol, including locally branded and OEM units from:

Eurom, Chigo, Tristar, Tecnomaster, Elgin, Geant, Tekno, Topair, Proma, Sumikura, JBS, Turbo Air, Nakatomy, Celestial Air, Ager, Blueway, Airlux, and other OEM/rebranded units using the same protocol.

Some other OEM families, including Midea/Comfee, use related IR control ecosystems, but they should not be assumed to use ZHLT01 without verification.

This codeset was tested and confirmed on a Komeco KOS 09QC 3HX. Compatibility with other models is not guaranteed and should be tested on the target unit.
